items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: But I played with Andrew that didn't burn, you know, when he was just high.

ctx.x: No, he didn't have him neither. But I played with Andrew that didn't burn, you know, when he was just high. But I remember Ake Martin's band and his brother Sam. I played with Sam before I played with Ake. Ake used to have a band for some crew from downtown. That's when I tell you a banjo player. You sit down and play and say, the guy can't play no banjo like me, the guy can't play no banjo like me. And the boys keep playing banjo you know. The boys kept looking and said one day he said, why don't you make a…
Ask me what the guy's name is about. The boys fired him, you know.
